extension.author: Guillaume Lajarige
extension.label: Markdown attributes viewer
extension.description: Easily edit fields in Markdown without any modification to your datamodel!
extension.version_description: * Fix rendering of HTML attributes (edited with the rich text editor) which were rendered on a single line * Fix security issue (XSS): HTML generated from the Markdown is now sanitized with DOMPurify, following the rules of the HTML sanitizer configured in iTop (`html_sanitizer` parameter) * Fix preview of HTML attributes not showing the last changes when opened right after typing * Fix paragraphs of plain text attributes being merged when their line endings are not CRLF (eg. value set through the REST API or an import) * Fix invalid classes / attributes in the `markdown_attributes` parameter breaking the display, they are now ignored
